role: In-memory, MainActor @Observable singleton holding the last 10 outbound LLM requests (system prompt, messages JSON, tools JSON, streamed response, usage, error) for the Troubleshooting prompt-audit page.
types: LLMRequestAudit: final class (@Observable @MainActor) — FIFO audit log
toplevel: Singleton `shared`; constants maxEntries 10 and maxPayloadCharacters 60000. Never persisted; cleared by the audit page's Clear button and DataPurgeService.purgeHealthCaches.

flags.text: File doc says 'Every provider's stream entry point pushes a record here' and refers to a nonexistent `update(...)` API; the only record() caller is AssistantViewModel.recordPromptAudit, and the update API is append/setUsage/setError.

Doc claims worst case ~10 × ~50 KB = ~500 KB, but each entry may hold four strings each capped at 60,000 characters (system prompt, messages, tools, response), i.e. up to ~2.4M characters across 10 entries.

units.does: Creates an Entry (new UUID, now, payloads capped to 60k chars, no usage, empty response), inserts it at index 0, trims entries to 10, returns the id.

branches.effect: drops the oldest tail entries; otherwise nothing

units.does: Appends a streamed text delta to the entry with that id, keeping only the last 60k characters; no-op if the entry was already evicted.

branches.effect: false: returns silently (entry evicted or cleared); true: appends
keeps the suffix 60k chars (drops the beginning)

units.does: Stores the usage block on the entry with that id; silently no-op if not found.
Stores an error description on the entry with that id; silently no-op if not found.

flags.text: setError has no caller anywhere in the repo, so Entry.errorDescription is always nil and the audit page can never show 'why did this turn fail' as the doc promises; failed turns look like empty successful ones.

units.does: Returns the string unchanged if ≤ 60k chars, else its first 60k chars plus '[…truncated N chars]'.

branches.effect: false: returns s; true: truncates and appends marker
